name: Safer chainsaw alternative (battery-powered carbide wire cutter)

mentions.name: Safer chainsaw alternative (battery-powered carbide wire cutter)
mentions.description: This project is a concept for a safer alternative to chainsaws: a carbide-coated wire driven by an electric motor and battery that is strapped to a tree and left to cut through it unattended over minutes, with an oscillating chain considered as an alternative to the wire. The design is still exploratory — the main difficulty is driving the wire without fast-wearing friction parts, and no workable implementation has been found yet.
mentions.problem: Chainsaws are dangerous; the idea was inspired by sharing a hospital room with a chainsaw accident victim, and no alternative to chainsaws has emerged in decades.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been thinking for years about a safer alternative to chain saws.  Something along the lines of a carbide coated wire driven by an electric motor and battery.  Strap it to the tree, turn it on, walk away and some minutes later the tree falls down.
